Answer: A
Reason: Figure 1 shows extensive consolidation in the left lung, while Figure 2 demonstrates resolution of this opacity with new consolidation appearing in the right upper lobe. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area accompanied by new opacities elsewhere is characteristic of the migratory pulmonary infiltrates seen in cryptogenic organizing pneumonia (COP).
